title: F126.3.1 runs: the overview
caption: Five parts: a conversation is played over the sessions API and graded, repeats decide a pass, a run is kept as one file, a site's API starts and follows a run, and a replay costs nothing. No page yet: the screens are F126.3.2's.

cards.title: F126.3.1 Runs
cards.code: an eval meets a live agent
cards.text: An eval file is played against the agent it names, graded, kept, followed, and replayed for free.

cards.title: A conversation is played
cards.text: One session, each turn asked in it and written down, then the facts and the judge's marks.

cards.title: Repeats decide a pass
cards.text: One repeat or three. A conversation passes only when every repeat does.

cards.title: A run is one file
cards.text: Written again after each conversation, so the file is the progress too.

cards.title: Started and followed
cards.text: The site's own API answers 202 and a reader asks the run how it goes.

cards.title: A replay is free
cards.text: A live run records the agent's and the judge's answers. A replay calls no model.
